input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement
input.rationale: The agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee payable by AP. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "damages", "minimum" and "shall pay" return nothing running against the Customer. Compensation is purely a revenue share of amounts actually generated (§5, p0023), and §13 expressly disclaims any minimum revenue guarantee. The only termination-related payment right (p0016) entitles Kubient to fees generated during the 90-day notice period — i.e., revenue actually earned from services rendered, not a pre-estimated or penal sum, and there is no lump-sum or remaining-term payment on early termination. This satisfies the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties), so no redline is required.
